summary: The Trump Administration formally opposed House passage of H.R. 1, the For the People Act of 2019. French Hill voted Nay on final passage, aligned with the Administration's documented position.
reviewNotes: House Clerk Roll Call 118 records Hill voting Nay. The March 5, 2019 Statement of Administration Policy states that the Administration opposes House passage of H.R. 1.

sources.label: Trump White House Statement of Administration Policy on H.R. 1
French Hill statement after voting against H.R. 1

summary: President Trump opposed the House impeachment effort. French Hill voted Nay on Article I of H. Res. 755, aligned with Trump's documented position.
reviewNotes: House Clerk Roll Call 695 records Hill voting Nay. A same-day White House statement condemned the House impeachment articles and defended the President against them.

sources.label: Trump White House statement on House impeachment
French Hill page summarizing Arkansas delegation impeachment votes

summary: President Trump opposed the House impeachment effort. French Hill voted No on Article II of H. Res. 755, aligned with Trump's documented position.
reviewNotes: House Clerk Roll Call 696 records Hill voting No. A same-day White House statement condemned the impeachment articles and defended the President against them.

summary: The Trump Administration strongly opposed S.J. Res. 68, the Iran War Powers resolution. French Hill voted No on House passage, aligned with the Administration's documented position.
reviewNotes: House Clerk Roll Call 101 records Hill voting No. The March 10, 2020 Statement of Administration Policy states that the Administration strongly opposes passage of S.J. Res. 68; Trump later vetoed the resolution.
